description: Attach an image (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, AVIF) or a PDF to a comment in layernote, for example a picture of how it looks after the fix. Give `url`, an https link layernote fetches itself (such as an image link from the Figma connector). For a file the user has on their computer, give no link: an upload panel opens in the chat and the user drags the file into it. Tell them so; an image pasted in the chat itself can’t be passed on. Only attach when the user asks.

project.description: The project, by name or id from list_projects. Only needed when the token reaches several projects

url.description: An https link to the image or PDF. layernote fetches it

name: add_attachment
title: Attach a file to a comment
